card.name: Book titles before 'this book examines'
card.fires_on: Words inside a book title, or a comma ending an opening phrase, right before the sentence names the book as its subject (e.g. 'this atlas examines', 'presents a collection'). Seen in book blurbs and catalog descriptions.

modes.label: Inside a book title
modes.description: A word within a title that is about to be followed by a verb like examines or presents.

modes.label: Comma before the book as subject
modes.description: A comma closing a descriptive phrase, right before 'this book/atlas' and its verb.
